comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a robot-axis damper; record removes foil from a sandwich and reheats it in a microwave.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests recessed tool engagement, fine mechanical adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling; record combines unwrapping, appliance access, placement, and controls.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires quantified safe carriage stops and retained adjustment. Board record omits setup, scoring, foil-removal verification, heating target, timing, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Safe food preparation and appliance operation do not test damper calibration or mechanical energy absorption.
